READABILITY.evidence: Constant names and docstrings are clear, but business logic is full of single-letter names (k, m, n, i in _parse_start_tag_at and the scanners). SVG_VISUAL_TAGS has a stray duplicate entry " symbol". Deeply nested branches in the main pass have few comments.

MAINTAINABILITY.evidence: One new file of 1151 lines. The main pass function (_run_pass) spans hundreds of lines with deep per-tag branching. The repeated '</script' boundary check is copy-pasted. Hex/dec/CSS entity replacers are near-duplicates. Magic loop counts (range(4), range(10)).

ROBUSTNESS.evidence: Explicit encoding with surrogateescape and newline="" on read and write. Exceptions caught are specific ValueErrors. Many magic iteration counts (range(2/3/4/10)). Usage error exits with no message (sys.exit(1)).

C6-01-CASE1.evidence: General rules throughout: a tokenising tag parser, multi-pass entity, percent and CSS decoding, CTRL_AND_SPACE_RE normalisation before the scheme check, a deny-list for script/object/embed/applet, checks on svg use/attributeName, iframe srcdoc sanitised recursively, null bytes stripped.

C6-01-CASE2.evidence: The hidden test test_clean_html_unchanged failed. Heuristics remove benign content: frameset is always removed, iframes without a safe src are dropped, any non-image data: URL is removed, style blocks with no declarations are dropped, svg with no visual child is removed. Edits are positional, though, so the formatting that survives is preserved.
